description: Split a source schema into fact and dimension tables from the foreign keys between them, and generate the star-schema DDL, the join keys and the model notes. When a warehouse needs a dimensional model sketched from sources. Do not choose this when a full normalisation or SCD design is required. Example requests: Design a star schema from this source schema. | Which tables are facts and which are dimensions? | Generate a star schema for this warehouse.

accepted_price.description: The quoted amount, echoed exactly; checked against the quote.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key; the same key returns the same job.

business_questions.description: The customer's questions.txt, as text. Supported: Plain text, one per line. Questions the model must answer. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

source_schema.description: The customer's schema.json, as text. Supported: JSON. The source tables and columns. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

payment_signature.description: x402 payment payload; required for a priced capability (see submit_job).

quote_id.description: The quote_id from POST /v1/jobs; required when priced.
